**Headline**  
Reduced security breaches by 40% through proactive threat modeling and compliance frameworks  

As a Senior Security Engineer with 15 years in consulting, I specialize in aligning technical expertise with business goals. My work bridges complex security challenges with practical solutions, ensuring clients meet regulatory standards while protecting critical assets. From designing encryption protocols to architecting IAM systems, I focus on building resilience that scales with business growth.  

My expertise spans penetration testing, SIEM integration, and vulnerability management—tools I’ve leveraged to strengthen defenses across industries. I’ve led application security initiatives that achieved OWASP Top 10 compliance, and crafted SOC2/GDPR frameworks that passed audits with zero critical findings. Network security remains central to my practice, with a track record of optimizing architectures to mitigate risks without compromising performance. Mentoring teams on access control principles and threat modeling has been key to fostering a security-first culture.  

Looking forward to connecting and sharing insights on security strategies and compliance best practices. Let’s collaborate on building safer, smarter systems.
